title: The unsolicited password-reset link — question explanation
learningObjective: Use official account-recovery paths and reject unsolicited reset links
format: 16:9 educational motion-graphics video; narration; separate captions; no autoplay with sound
visualStyle: Deep navy and charcoal; restrained cyan/electric-blue highlights; limited purple accents; clean typography; purposeful, low-motion transitions; accessible contrast.

scenes.name: Scenario setup
scenes.visual: You receive a password-reset SMS for a service while you are not attempting to reset your password. A second message asks you to approve the reset.
scenes.direction: Show a fictional simulated setting. Use generic UI and no actual organization, brand, user identity, credential, real URL or live account.

scenes.name: Learning objective and risk cue
scenes.visual: Use official account-recovery paths and reject unsolicited reset links
scenes.direction: Highlight only observable cues and explain the decision context without implying certainty beyond the scenario.

scenes.name: Recommended response
scenes.visual: Option B: Ignore the link, navigate independently to the service and review account security or contact support if needed. Unsolicited reset messages should be verified through the official service rather than followed.
scenes.direction: Animate the recommended defensive choice as a clear decision path. Display the action verb and trusted channel/control.

scenes.name: Why the other options fail
scenes.visual: Option A: The code may authorize an attacker-controlled reset. Option C: Approving a reset you did not request may give another party control of the account. Option D: The link could lead to a credential-harvesting site.
scenes.direction: Show each unsafe alternative separately with a complete, concise reason. Do not depict operational exploitation, malicious code or credential capture.

scenes.name: Defensive takeaway
scenes.visual: Do not open the SMS link or share a code. Access the service independently and report repeated or suspicious recovery activity. Only initiate recovery yourself through the official service; do not approve an unsolicited reset.
scenes.direction: Close with one readable takeaway and the next safe action. Keep the final frame long enough for comprehension.
scenes.onScreenText: Only initiate recovery yourself through the official service; do not approve an unsolicited reset.

Key takeaway: Only initiate recovery yourself through the official service; do not approve an unsolicited reset.
